newsitem.title: UK: Imperial Tobacco down on NatWest comment.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Tobacco down on NatWest comment.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Tobacco Group Plc dropped on Thursday as analysts at NatWest Securities warned over the impact of a threatened UK tobacco lawsuit, traders said.
The stock was down 3p at 383 by 1115 GMT in active trade of 1.8 million shares.
Imperial made its market debut earlier this month after being spun off from conglomerate Hanson Plc and today's drop took it to the lowest level since it joined the market.
NatWest analysts were not immediately available for comment.
Last month, 40 cancer sufferers said they planned to sue Imperial and Gallaher, in the process of being spun off from American Brands Inc, in a group action.

Yesterday analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing issued a "sell" rating on Imperial because of the perceived risk that the company will undertake an ill-advised international expansion to compete with rivals such as B.A.T Industries Plc.
